Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.
 WHY JOIN US
 If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 We are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer/SRE to design, build, and maintain cloud environments, including infrastructure as code, Kubernetes deployments, and the observability stack.
 MUST HAVES
 - At least 4+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
 - Proven expertise building and managing infrastructure using Terraform.
 - Demonstrated experience using GitOps practices (e.g., ArgoCD or Flux) for automated deployments.
- Experience deploying, configuring, and managing production Kubernetes clusters.
 - Proficiency in Python programming for infrastructure automation and tooling.
 - Direct experience configuring and operating any of the following:
- Grafana (dashboards and metrics visualization)
- Loki (log aggregation)
- Thanos (Prometheus long-term storage and high availability)
- Tempo (distributed tracing)
- Demonstrated background in designing and testing High Availability (HA) architectures and Disaster Recovery (DR) failover plans.
 - Upper-intermediate English level.
 NICE TO HAVES
 - Familiarity with additional languages such as Go (Golang) or Rust for cloud tools.
- Experience with Service Mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD).
- Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, GCP Professional Cloud Architect).
 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 - Cloud & Infrastructure as Code: Provision, manage, and scale cloud infrastructure using Terraform.
- GitOps & Kubernetes: Deploy and maintain production Kubernetes clusters using declarative GitOps workflows.
- Automation Engineering: Write production Python code to create custom tools, automation scripts, and platform integrations.
- Observability: Maintain system telemetry using Grafana, Tempo, Loki, and Thanos for logging, metrics, and tracing.
- High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Implement and test HA and DR strategies to satisfy strict uptime and recovery requirements.
 PERKS AND BENEFITS
 - Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime : Flexible schedule with remote and office options.
 Meet Our Recruitment Process
 Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.
